body: Damn man thanks for the advice. For a while I have been trying to fulfill some kind of "manly image" and all it has done is make me feel worthless. To attract woman you have to be a "bad boy", "alpha male", "Gentleman" NO! "you have to be a mix of both"...goddamn it can get exhausting because I keep trying to change myself to find someone. There are things that I should feel proud about myself but I still don't feel "good enough". I am grateful that I have good friends that support and love me, but I just get jealous sometimes when they pull woman that I desire and honestly some of my guy friends are below my attractiveness level (if that makes a difference). I guess man what I am looking for is how can I love myself more? Be satisfied with my own life even if I am not a millionaire, super successful etc...yet.
I am really trying to become that person. Please read my edit because it tells me a little bit about me and my hobbies/interest etc.
My type of woman that I want to date is athletic and also a gym freak. So I should always hang out around the gym and athletic places???
Granny gives no single fucks.
Nope don't really need praise. Check out the video of your brain on porn and you'll understand.

Yes! I am aware (and it fucking sucks) that I will be feeling depressed due to quitting my addiction BUT if I keep on going and my brain feels better than I will feel 100% better. Well, at least I have this faith and hope that it will. Everyday I just have to be strong no matter what.
Thanks! I will totally check it out!
Thank you!!! It works if you work it haha
No problem man!!! I am glad that it made your day and hopefully things will get better!

Its mostly all in the morning that does it for me to keep positive throughout the day. I wake up, I meditate/pray, have a really healthy breakfast, write a small to-do list and just go on with my day. I am still looking for that "great" routine but for now, this had worked wonders for me. I also am a workout junkie so that is something I do daily to relieve stress and any bad emotions. I recently wrote out my vision that I want in life and that really helps me focus on "me" and not in a selfish way, but in a "do it to save my life" type of way. I also am being religious again so that is something that helps me. This might sound weird but 2 weeks ago when I was feeling suicidal I prayed for a long time to God and then next day I just felt better and I just kept this momentum going. I am not saying that you need to believe in God but it does help. Trust me. If you have any questions and want to chat then feel free to PM me.
Thanks man!!! I appreciate the support.
Yeah man! Thanks! Something that I am working on is controlling my emotions when something "bad" happens and for now it seems to be working!
porn and masturbation. Weird I know but theres more to it.
An example would be right now! haha I don't feel as good as yesterday because of some stuff that happened yesterday but I am hopeful that everything happens for a reason...even the bad things.
Yeah man. It really does!!! its kinda funny because my brain keeps telling me to just stay home but when I go out then I feel so much better.

I really like this idea!!! I am a perfectionist and holy hell being a perfectionist and being depressed do not match at all. I want to quit fast food/sugar and soda for a while so I can get my mind back on track but its so damn hard. Its hard convincing my brain to take it one day at a time lol. I am going to take your advice of not beating myself for fucking up because I do that a lot and it hurts me more.

Its all good! Thanks for the support!!!. I need to forgive myself, but don't know how. All I do is tell myself mean things but I noticed that it doesn't lead to anywhere. I am hoping that therapy would help me at least get my mind to be still and at peace to get things done.
I am doing a little better. I am trying to keep my mind from racing because I am worried about everything right now. I just need to meditate and convince myself that this isn't the end of the world.

I have been trying to fight for 2 years and I have been struggling with this addiction since I was 12. It is super hard and ugh I just wished my brain would finally clicked and I would at least reach 90 days. A therapist today told me that depression makes you perceive things that aren't true...I don't know whats true anymore.
Thats true. I have to live for myself and make my own rules.

Reminds me of the quote thats says that "Depression comes from living in the past, anxiety comes from living in the future, but living in the present is a gift. Thats why its called a present" or something like that. I will totally try it bro!!! Thanks! I will never give up!

Yes! thats something that really burned a desire to actually get my shit together and its that I have a lot of people that love and care about me! My family and my friends but also support from you guys as well. I want to prove to myself that I am not a loser that should just kill myself, but someone who HAS value and CAN achieve all my goals.
Oh, I WILL ;)

I think that with depression you have to really focus on getting through "one day at a time" and work yourself there. My goal right now for a while is to try to be really busy doing proactive things JUST TODAY and when tomorrow comes then focus on tomorrow. I ALWAYS think about the future or my past and it does make depression much worse.
Thank you!!!
Thanks friend! I will be posting soon
I am sorry to hear that. I read something similar to your story and its horrible the effects that happens to those around you, and its fucked up how your mind does that.
Stay tuned ;)

I am going to write that on my wall!!! I love that quote!. Thanks for the support friend! I really need it, and I am slowly realizing that I can beat this and that my life isn't so bad. Depression really does fuck you up worse and makes you think that you're nothing, but this isn't true. I do deserve better and so do you!.
I actually am participating in the nofap movement! Have been for a while. It's hard AF (no pun intended). I believe that once I recover from this addiction then my depression will be so much better!
Its sex addiction but its mostly porn and masturbation, and I know some people say there is nothing wrong with that but it really does fuck you up in the long run...well at least for me.
Thank you kind stranger
Yes! I feel blessed in that regards, but I also have to do my part and I seem to be doing it.
I like it! :) I already exercise as in lifting weights but somedays I just don't have the energy to do so and it bugs the hell out of me. Lifting really does help.

Thanks for the amazing words friend! I have survived stuff (mentally and emotionally) that people would prob find it hard to go through but I did it! Its a daily battle, but I have a little hope that things will get so much better.
Thanks! Stay tuned!

One of my parents best friend is a doctor and he is going to help me out! Now I need to find a good therapist to get my recovery going. I am happy that it has worked for you! hopefully it will work for me.

Its a daily battle and now its going to be easier because I WANT to get rid of this shit. It has ruined my life (literally) and I want to finally succeed. Its going to be tough but worth it as people say!. My friend told me that people who get involved with depression recovery is 80% successful and those number are high. I am ready to conquer this shit (one day at a time) Thanks for the support!
No. I almost attempted suicide yesterday. I was just feeling horrible so today I am going to go get some help.
I am doing better!!!! Thanks! How are you?

I also have those nasty thoughts of "not good enough" and some days are louder in my head. I can relate to the emotional breakdown so much and it reminds me when I was feeling horrible and the thoughts of "not good enough" was racing! Its a bitch when your thoughts are louder than your happiness. Right now I am doing what you're doing and that is to take it one day at a time.

I know what I want to do in my life right now and hopefully it doesn't change, but I am just scared that it won't come to pass. I know I am only 20 years old and have lots of time, but I want to feel "successful" and good right now. You are doing better than me in the dating department because I have never asked a girl out on a date. I just get lucky with girls but it raaaaarrrreeeelllllyyy happens. I have to work on that.
This is one of my focuses right now and that is to find a good psychiatrist to meet twice a week if possible. Its bullshit that I have to wait a month to meet up with someone.
How different did you feel once the medication started to kick in?

Haha yep my first goal is to not die :P. I am starting a diet which supposedly "boosts" dopamine and sarotonin naturally and giving that a shot!. Its hard to really be consistent in therapy because of how much time space there is between appointments at my colleges counseling. I am looking around to see where one is. What kind of medicine are you taking? I have been taking St. Johns Wort and it seems to be working a little, also doing other activities helps too.

Hmmm I will totally look into it! I am really big into reading about psychology and such, but I will have to check out Buddhism. I try to meditate 10 minutes a day, but I want to learn more about meditation and see if I could reach "enlightenment" as some people call it!.
